scenario: LGRA.2.9.6 / LLET.12.5 — a `let` bound to a v1 method call renders its RESULT when interpolated. A pure let inlines into the segment per LLET.12.5. This pins the rendered VALUE: a lowering whose catch-all emits a literal `false` renders the text "false" with nothing reporting an error, since the rule fires and the log line is emitted.
rules_ds:
schema Ev scope logical:
    id: Int key
    ts: Time

rule r:
    Ev e
->
    let s = e.ts.to_string("iso8601")
    log critical "at {s}"
